THE PLATE: A young Indian woman, late twenties, warm mid-brown skin with golden undertones. Long dark brown hair in loose natural waves. Bare shoulders, marigold-saffron silk camisole with narrow spaghetti straps. Nails short, bare, pale nude, no polish colour. Warm cream seamless with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A COLOURED DROP NECKLACE: a fine gold cable chain with about thirteen small faceted stones hanging along the front at even spacing, each in its own thin gold bezel: oval and pear stones in pale green, lilac, pink, yellow and blue, the colours alternating. Small single drops only, evenly spaced, in mixed pastel colours; no clusters, no clear stones, no pearls.

SCALE TEST: Worn, the drops spread across the collarbones, each smaller than a fingernail. The jewellery keeps its true small size against the body; it is read by bringing the camera closer, never by making the piece bigger.

ABSENCE LIST: No eyes, no eyebrows, no forehead. No second piece of jewellery, no watch, no other rings, no other earrings, no necklace unless it is the product. No nail polish colour. No props, no flowers. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
